title: Nutty Velvety Irish Basmati Rice Pilaf
description: A lacto-vegetarian friendly Irish dish featuring basmati rice, coconut cream, and citrus flavors, perfect for a brunch mood. This recipe combines the creaminess of coconut with the nuttiness of basmati rice.
instructions: Rinse the basmati rice in a fine mesh sieve until the water runs clear.
In a medium saucepan, melt the unsalted butter over medium heat.
Add the orange zest and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the basmati rice and cook for 2 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the coconut cream, orange juice, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Fluff the rice with a fork and stir in the chopped pecans.
Serve the pilaf hot, garnished with additional orange zest if desired.
